fields.label: Phone Display
fields.name: phone_display
fields.instructions: Optional: enter a custom display format for the phone number.

fields.label: Header Sticky
fields.name: sticky
fields.instructions: Check this box to make header sticky

fields.label: Header Background Color
fields.name: header_background_color
fields.instructions: Choose a theme color, a custom solid color, or a linear gradient. Leave empty to use the default background.

fields.label: Header Background Gradient
fields.name: header_background_gradient
fields.instructions: Paste a full CSS gradient value, e.g. linear-gradient(180deg, #000000 0%, #333333 100%).

fields.label: Footer Background Color
fields.name: footer_background_color
fields.instructions: Choose a theme color, a custom solid color, or a linear gradient. Leave empty to keep the default (black).

fields.label: Footer Background Gradient
fields.name: footer_background_gradient
fields.instructions: Paste a full CSS gradient value, e.g. linear-gradient(180deg, #000000 0%, #333333 100%).

fields.label: Group
fields.name: hero_banners
fields.instructions: Site-wide hero fallbacks. Per-post-type rows let you enable Hero for any post type (including future ones) without touching code. A post's own Hero Override (if set) always wins over these defaults.

sub_fields.label: Enable Site-wide Default Banners
sub_fields.name: enable_sitewide_default
sub_fields.instructions: If off, none of the images/colors below are used as a fallback anywhere — treated the same as if they were empty.

sub_fields.label: Minimum Height Desktop (px)
sub_fields.name: min_height_desktop
sub_fields.instructions: Applies to every hero site-wide — Theme Settings and the flexible content Hero module alike. Leave empty for the default (300px).

sub_fields.label: Minimum Height Mobile (px)
sub_fields.name: min_height_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for the default (300px).

sub_fields.label: Gradient
sub_fields.name: default_single_background_gradient
sub_fields.instructions: Paste a full CSS gradient value, e.g. linear-gradient(180deg, #000000 0%, #333333 100%).

sub_fields.label: Overlay Color
sub_fields.name: default_single_overlay_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional tinted layer on top of the image, for text readability. Leave empty for no overlay.

sub_fields.label: Gradient
sub_fields.name: default_archive_background_gradient
sub_fields.instructions: Paste a full CSS gradient value, e.g. linear-gradient(180deg, #000000 0%, #333333 100%).

sub_fields.label: Overlay Color
sub_fields.name: default_archive_overlay_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional tinted layer on top of the image, for text readability. Leave empty for no overlay.

sub_fields.label: Gradient
sub_fields.name: default_taxonomy_background_gradient
sub_fields.instructions: Paste a full CSS gradient value, e.g. linear-gradient(180deg, #000000 0%, #333333 100%).

sub_fields.label: Overlay Color
sub_fields.name: default_taxonomy_overlay_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional tinted layer on top of the image, for text readability. Leave empty for no overlay.

sub_fields.label: Post Type Hero Settings
sub_fields.name: hero_post_type_settings
sub_fields.instructions: Add a row per post type to enable its hero banner. New post types just need a new row here — no code changes required.

sub_fields.label: Singular Default Image
sub_fields.name: default_single_image
sub_fields.instructions: Used on single posts of this type unless a post overrides it or has a featured image.

sub_fields.label: Gradient
sub_fields.name: single_background_gradient
sub_fields.instructions: Paste a full CSS gradient value, e.g. linear-gradient(180deg, #000000 0%, #333333 100%).

sub_fields.label: Overlay Color
sub_fields.name: single_overlay_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional tinted layer on top of the image, for text readability. Leave empty for no overlay.

sub_fields.label: Archive Default Image
sub_fields.name: default_archive_image
sub_fields.instructions: Used on this post type's archive page.

sub_fields.label: Gradient
sub_fields.name: archive_background_gradient
sub_fields.instructions: Paste a full CSS gradient value, e.g. linear-gradient(180deg, #000000 0%, #333333 100%).

sub_fields.label: Overlay Color
sub_fields.name: archive_overlay_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional tinted layer on top of the image, for text readability. Leave empty for no overlay.

sub_fields.label: Taxonomy Hero Settings
sub_fields.name: hero_taxonomy_settings
sub_fields.instructions: Add a row per taxonomy to give it its own default banner. Used when a term of that taxonomy doesn't have its own Hero set. New taxonomies just need a new row here — no code changes required.

sub_fields.label: Default Image
sub_fields.name: default_image
sub_fields.instructions: Used for any term of this taxonomy that doesn't have its own Hero image set.

sub_fields.label: Gradient
sub_fields.name: background_gradient
sub_fields.instructions: Paste a full CSS gradient value, e.g. linear-gradient(180deg, #000000 0%, #333333 100%).

sub_fields.label: Overlay Color
sub_fields.name: overlay_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional tinted layer on top of the image, for text readability. Leave empty for no overlay.
